Formula Given the sampled distance d and clockwise-from-north bearing beta, planar p=c+d*(sin(beta),cos(beta)). On a sphere the shared half-angle destination is used: phi=pi*c.y/180, delta=d/R, sineChange=-2*sin(phi)*sin(delta/2)^2+cos(phi)*sin(delta)*cos(beta) (sin(phi2)-sin(phi) without cancellation), sin(phi2)=clamp(sin(phi)+sineChange,-1,1), deltaPhi=2*asin(sineChange/(2*cos((phi+phi2)/2))) (asin(sin(phi2))-phi when that cosine is at most 1e-3), deltaLambda=atan2(sin(beta)*sin(delta)*cos(phi),cos(delta)-sin(phi)*sin(phi2)), and p=c+180/pi*(deltaLambda,deltaPhi). Circles sample negative full-turn bearings, sectors sample their clockwise sweep with center spokes, and ellipses derive d and beta from rotated scaled axes (optionally using the arc-length table). This is the destination core for finite centers; invalid centers emit NaN.

Given the sampled distance d and clockwise-from-north bearing beta, planar p=c+d*(sin(beta),cos(beta)). On a sphere the shared half-angle destination is used: phi=pi*c.y/180, delta=d/R, sineChange=-2*sin(phi)*sin(delta/2)^2+cos(phi)*sin(delta)*cos(beta) (sin(phi2)-sin(phi) without cancellation), sin(phi2)=clamp(sin(phi)+sineChange,-1,1), deltaPhi=2*asin(sineChange/(2*cos((phi+phi2)/2))) (asin(sin(phi2))-phi when that cosine is at most 1e-3), deltaLambda=atan2(sin(beta)*sin(delta)*cos(phi),cos(delta)-sin(phi)*sin(phi2)), and p=c+180/pi*(deltaLambda,deltaPhi). Circles sample negative full-turn bearings, sectors sample their clockwise sweep with center spokes, and ellipses derive d and beta from rotated scaled axes (optionally using the arc-length table). This is the destination core for finite centers; invalid centers emit NaN.
